# Contributing to WooCommerce M-Pesa Tanzania

Thank you for considering contributing to our project! Here's how you can help:

## Getting Started

1. Fork the repository
2. Clone your fork: `git clone https://github.com/YOUR-USERNAME/wc-mpesa-tanzania.git`
3. Create a feature branch: `git checkout -b feature/your-feature-name`
4. Make your changes
5. Run tests: `phpunit`
6. Commit your changes: `git commit -am 'Add your feature'`
7. Push to the branch: `git push origin feature/your-feature-name`
8. Submit a pull request

## Coding Standards

- Follow [WordPress Coding Standards](https://developer.wordpress.org/coding-standards/)
- Use PSR-12 for PHP code style
- Write tests for new features
- Maintain at least 80% code coverage

## Pull Request Guidelines

- One feature per pull request
- Clear commit messages
- Update documentation as needed
- Ensure all tests pass
- Add any breaking changes to CHANGELOG

## Reporting Issues

- Use GitHub Issues for bug reports
- Include:
  - WordPress version
  - WooCommerce version
  - PHP version
  - Steps to reproduce
  - Error logs
  - Expected vs. actual behavior

## Code of Conduct

- Be respectful and inclusive
- No harassment or discrimination
- Constructive feedback only
- Focus on the code, not the person

Thank you for contributing! 🙏
